hero.title: Permissions, only when needed
hero.subtitle: Internet · clipboard · photos
hero.speech: We ask for permissions when a feature needs them. You can decline optional permissions.

network.name: Internet connection
network.why: Needed to sign in, save records, and get SecondB replies. Uses a standard HTTPS connection.

clipboard.name: Clipboard
clipboard.why: Used only when you tap Copy in export or message actions. 2nd-Brain never reads your clipboard in the background.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.why: Optional and only used for Routines. When you send an approved item to your calendar, your device asks for permission once. You can check the event before saving it. Other features still work if you decline.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.why: Optional and only used for routine reminders. Your device asks for permission once when you schedule a reminder. Reminders stay on this device. Other features still work if you decline.

cameraPhoto.name: Camera / Photo library
cameraPhoto.why: Optional and only used to read text from photos. Permission is requested when you use a photo feature. Other features still work if you decline.

microphone.name: Microphone
microphone.why: Voice input asks for microphone access. Recorded audio is sent to an AI server to turn it into text.

location.name: Location
location.why: Not requested. The app has no location-based features.

contactsSms.name: Contacts / SMS
contactsSms.why: The app does not request access to your device contacts or text messages.

principles.title: Principles
items: We check which permissions are needed before adding a feature.
Declining optional permissions does not prevent you from using other features.
The app accesses your clipboard or photos only when you choose an action that needs them.
Each permission request includes a short explanation.
Each account can access only its own records. Export remains available.

manual.accessibilityHint: Opens the user guide from the permissions screen.
